item.title: Beyond Leaderboards: A Method for Application-Specific Capability Profiling of Large Language Models
item.description:
This research offers a way to test and score large language models (LLMs) for a specific task, like a migration bot or chatbot, instead of just looking at general leaderboard scores. The authors built a containerised testbed where each application runs its own dataset, evaluation metrics and contract, giving a clear picture of how an LLM will perform and what cost it will incur. The result is a more accurate, cost‑aware model selection process that helps you pick the right LLM for a given workload.

IT Breakdown: If you manage cloud infrastructure, here is what to do: 1. Deploy the authors’ containerised testbed in your environment. 2. Add your application’s dataset and evaluation scripts to the container. 3. Run the profiling to see which LLM meets your performance and cost targets before you spin up production instances.

item.title: [News] OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
item.description: OpenAI has acquired biotechnology startup Orchestra Bio, integrating its team and technology into the Rosalind AI model and the Rosalind Workbench tool for life science research. This move expands OpenAI’s presence in the biotech sector and enhances its capabilities for experimental design and data analysis.

item.title: [News] Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
item.description: Anthropic is facing compute shortages from cloud providers who see it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spend rises ahead of an IPO. This reflects a shift in cloud resource allocation that could affect the availability of Anthropic’s models for enterprise customers.

item.title: [News] Advancing digital sovereignty with greater control and choice
item.description: Microsoft is announcing a new initiative focused on enhancing digital sovereignty for government and regulated industries, emphasizing greater control over cloud and AI deployments. The goal is to enable critical systems to use advanced technology while preserving strict security and compliance requirements.

item.title: [News] SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
item.description: SpaceX’s AI division has outperformed financial expectations, contributing significantly to a $4.4 billion net income in Q3. The company’s AI initiatives are now a key profitability driver.

item.title: [News] OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
item.description: OpenAI has announced its acquisition of Orchestra Bio, a company focused on AI‑powered operations for life sciences R&D. The deal aims to help biopharma teams accelerate drug development by integrating advanced AI into their workflows.
